content.text: A register of the loyalty programme's members. Programme staff browse, search and maintain one record per member: identity and contact details, their tier and membership status, their points balance, the cards we issued them, and who referred them. This is the reference register the programme's other processes will hang off; it does not itself run the programme.
the member register — create, browse, search, edit and close out member records, each carrying a home address, a list of issued cards and an optional referring member.

earning, spending or adjusting points (the balance is a field here; the movements that change it are not), tier assignment or upgrade rules, sending marketing emails (only the consent flag is recorded), card issuance workflow, joining/signup flow.

Implied by the bean blocks in the Data model and regenerated by the platform - do not edit this block; author above it what the catalog cannot derive.

Member - persistence.entity (persistence): The entity class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry, its migration and table, and its tests; the descriptor is authored at spec time as the bean's entity-descriptor attachment (entity_descriptors/{qualified-descriptor-name}.json).
Member - observer.sheet (observer): The observer sheet: the entity's only remote surface, reads and writes.

Member - ui.defaultForm (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js attachment and shipped beside the entity class.
